name: com.xpturn.feedback
description: Game feel feedbacks for Unity 6 URP, driven by a PlayerLoop scheduler with non-destructive property layers, zero-GC playback and edit-mode preview.

samples.description: Getting Started (complete and empty) and the Feedback Gallery — every feedback type and the default presets.
S3 Before / After, S4 Combat Hit Lab, S5 Camera Shake Lab (a Cinemachine card too), S6 Spring Playground and S10 PostFX Lab — layers of feedback, hits, camera shakes, springs and post effects.

S7 UI Juice — a shop screen whose feedback keeps moving while the game is paused: hovers, delayed HP and XP bars, a reward popup · S15 UI Trigger — feedback wired to uGUI events with no code: hovers that turn back, a toggle, a slider and a press that waits for its release.

S8 Timeline & Flow (start rules, loops, a signal, reverse, seek, a runtime timeline) · S9 Channels & Range (channel sends, a distance gate) · S11 Stress & Zero-GC (thousands of players, the frame's allocation, a coroutine baseline) · S12 Accessibility (category settings applied live) · S14 Unity Timeline Cutscene (the Timeline package: Feedback tracks with Driven and Triggered clips and a Signal, previewed in the Timeline window).
S13 Showcase (a short brick-breaker round: a combo that grows the feedback by intensity range, a score count-up, a boss's entrance, hits, rage and defeat, the same game with the feedback off).
